theorems.name: Submission.dorag_ha_pb_pair_sq_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (u : Euclid n → ℝ) (L : NNReal), LipschitzWith L u → ∀ᵐ p : Euclid n × Euclid n, (u p.1 - u p.2) ^ 2 ≤ ‖p.1 - p.2‖ ^ 2 * ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, ‖fderiv ℝ u ((1 - t) • p.2 + t • p.1)‖ ^ 2
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
